settings.description: Show more than nine ammunition entries in the in-mission ammo menu by adding columns to its three rows. Enabled by default. Experimental. Requires selection and ammunition enabled. Disabling restores the normal menu size; it does not remove weapons or ammo. Does not affect out-of-mission squad-management scrolling. Restart required.

Number of columns in the in-mission ammo menu, with three entries per column. 3-42 columns show 9-126 entries; entries beyond that capacity stay hidden. Wide menus may extend off screen. Does not give squads more ammo or increase their carrying capacity. Requires expanded ammo menu enabled. Restart required.

Show ammunition from all selected infantry squads together, with ammo-level bars, average active reload progress, and enabled/total counts for mixed weapon states. Clicking a mixed or disabled type enables it for all selected users; clicking a fully enabled type disables it. Enabled by default. Experimental. False keeps the focused-squad view while retaining the larger menu. Individual-soldier overrides still cover only the first eight ammo slots; select whole squads for later slots. Requires expanded ammo menu enabled. Restart required.
